summary: Deduplicated discussion signals: Anthropic Claude Code changes and Grok Build security story are highest priority; operator reports highlight MCP switching costs, prompt-injection risks, and real-world agent deployments; evaluation and security harnesses (Harbor, RAS‑Eval) gaining attention. | Vendor-only snapshot: security incidents and advisories (Cursor, GHSA/Claude), vendor product launches (OpenAI Wallet, Mistral Studio), infra patterns for agent runtimes/sandboxes (AWS AgentCore, Modal, E2B), and operator-facing guidance (JetBrains, AWS cost controls). Missing independent social/operator threads in this shard. | GitHub-only shard: mix of high-confidence vendor releases (GitHub, Microsoft, OpenAI, Anthropic, Vercel), major OSS agent platforms, and several infra/security primitives; social/user-workflow coverage missing. | Package-only shard: many infra primitives and VS Code operator extensions; Amazon official agents and OpenAI VSIX stand out. Missing social discussion and vendor changelogs for Anthropic/Google/Microsoft.
